newsitem.title: UK: Guinness Peat sells some assets.
newsitem.headline: Guinness Peat sells some assets.

text.p: Investment group Guinness Peat Group Plc said it sold indirectly held shares in one Australian company, while also planning to sell its stake in another.

Guinness Peat said its subsidiary Mid East Minerals Ltd (MEM) reduced its stake to 19.5 percent from 83 percent in MEx, which bought back own shares from Guinness Peat for a consideration of 11.1 million stg.
Guinness Peat held an 89.7 percent stake in MEM per December 31.
It said it also intends to accept an offer for its entire stake in investment company ASC Limited, which would raise 8.3 million stg.
Guinness Peat held 52.6 percent in ASC at December 31.
The offer for the ASC stake is being made by the newly formed company ASC All Ordinary Index Fund Pty Limited.
The sales will result in the new "compact and simple" company structure outlined when Guinness Peat announced its results on March 11, the company said.
